name: Crossover
description: Marvel event tie-in guide as an MCP service — answers "we just finished this issue, what's next and which tie-ins expand on it?" from inside a conversation.

CROSSOVER_ADMIN_KEY.description: Gates the curation views and the OAuth consent screen. Generated per-deploy so no two installs share one, and so nothing has to be pasted from a public README.

CROSSOVER_PUBLIC_URL.description: The https URL this app will be reachable at, e.g. https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com — use the app name you chose above. This is the OAuth issuer and is checked by the MCP transport, so a Claude connector cannot attach if it is wrong. It can be corrected after deploy.

CROSSOVER_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Creates the first reader, so you can sign in immediately. The allowlist is deliberately small — reading lists are per-person.

CROSSOVER_OWNER_HANDLE.description: Short lowercase login name for the first reader, e.g. "dave". It also names that reader's password variable, CROSSOVER_PASSWORD_<HANDLE>. Letters, digits and underscores only.

CROSSOVER_PASSWORD_OWNER.description: Password for the first reader, if you keep the default handle "owner". Generated per-deploy; read it back from Settings -> Config Vars, or change it to something memorable. Each additional reader needs their own CROSSOVER_PASSWORD_<HANDLE>.

UI_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Adds the Secure flag to the session cookie. Leave as true; Heroku serves https.

OTEL_ENABLED.description: OpenTelemetry export. Off by default — the collector it targets is a local Grafana Alloy, which a dyno cannot reach. Set true only if you have a reachable OTLP endpoint.
